verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a host-controlled gate on guest access: the host controls exactly which apps connected guests are approved to see and interact with, and guest access is granted only to invited people. That gives some host-side approval over who can view or control the screen, but nothing describes device-level pairing or a per-device approval prompt before first connection. missing for 10: explicit new-device pairing or approval step, documentation of the approval flow before viewing or control, independent or hands-on corroboration.
